title: Get Started With Meta Muse in Python: Spark and Glimmer
description: Get started with Meta Muse in Python. Make your first Muse Spark call, then add streaming, images, and tool calls, and try the open-weights Glimmer.
summary: Getting started with Meta Muse in Python takes only a few lines of code, because Meta’s Model API speaks the same protocol as OpenAI’s. Knowing what you get for your money takes a bit longer.
